title: Evaluating Semantic Interaction on Word Embeddings via Simulation
reasoning: The paper uses the 20 Newsgroups dataset for its quantitative analysis. One of the evaluation tasks, 'Treligion', involves classifying and separating documents from two religion-themed newsgroups: 'talk.religion.misc' and 'soc.religion.christian'. This uses religious topics as a basis for evaluating the performance of the semantic interaction models.
